theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : NNReal), (∀ (A : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (f : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ ∧ (∀ t, μHE[n] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ φ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, φ t ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n + 1] A) → ∀ (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (Z : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), ContDiff ℝ 1 F → (∀ y ∈ Z, fderiv ℝ F y = 0) → ∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}) = 0
